notes.subject: הנסה דבר אליך תלאה
notes.rationale: read as questions (YLT 'Hath one tried a word with thee? Thou art weary!') or conditionals (KJV 'If we assay…wilt thou be grieved?'); verb subject and mood both disputed

notes.subject: les
notes.rationale: לאה is to tire/be disgusted; 'les' (weary/reluctant) covers both senses in Tok Pisin

notes.subject: to Iyov
notes.rationale: Eliphaz opens his speech with a hesitant question addressed directly to Job

translation: Sapos wanpela i traim tokim wanpela tok long yu, bai yu les? Tasol long holimpas tok, husat i inap?
